steps.code:
# Collect all downloaded song IDs across all pages
downloaded_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        downloaded_song_ids.add(song['song_id'])
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total downloaded songs: {len(downloaded_song_ids)}")
print(downloaded_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Check if current song is downloaded, if not, go to next until we find one
max_steps = 100
steps = 0
while steps < max_steps:
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    print(f"Step {steps}: current song id={current['song_id']}, title={current['title']}")
    if current['song_id'] in downloaded_song_ids:
        print(f"Found downloaded song: {current['title']} (id={current['song_id']})")
        break
    # Go to next song
    next_result = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    print(f"Next song result: {next_result}")
    steps += 1
else:
    print("Did not find a downloaded song within max steps")
